title: News & current affairs (B1)
note: Course-doc theme, above leaf_society_a2. Basic news literacy: the headline, the report, who governs. Feeds trunk_opinions_b1 and the second-conditional discussion work. First draft 2026-09-02, rough. · 2026-09-04 B1 loop: sentences 8 → 36, one gappable frame per lemma. E10: Use is use_mode rewrite, 12 underlined paraphrases, not CZ→EN of the bank. F7: six tiles an earlier pack already owns were replaced with news lexis that is new here — article→broadcast, daily→coverage, abroad→scandal, agreement→vote, development→issue, peace→campaign. A12: four tiles are the same string in a different sense and are sense-marked instead — party (political), interview (in the news), report (a news story), fall (a drop). Pool-checked against everything taught before leaf_news_b1 — 0 unknown types.

intro.title: You will use these words in

sentences.en: I read the headline but not the article, because I was late for work.
sentences.cz: Přečetl jsem titulek, ale ne článek, protože jsem měl zpoždění do práce.
accepts: I read the headline but not the article, because I was late for work

sentences.en: The government will announce a new law about taxes.
sentences.cz: Vláda oznámí nový zákon o daních.
accepts: The government will announce a new law about taxes
The government'll announce a new law about taxes

sentences.en: There is an election next year, but nobody knows who will win.
sentences.cz: Příští rok jsou volby, ale nikdo neví, kdo vyhraje.
accepts: There is an election next year, but nobody knows who will win
There's an election next year, but nobody knows who will win

sentences.en: The economy is stronger than it was when my parents were young.
sentences.cz: Ekonomika je silnější, než byla, když byli moji rodiče mladí.
accepts: The economy is stronger than it was when my parents were young

sentences.en: She works as a journalist, but she started as a teacher.
sentences.cz: Pracuje jako novinářka, ale začínala jako učitelka.
accepts: She works as a journalist, but she started as a teacher

sentences.en: Thousands of people joined the protest because the prices were too high.
sentences.cz: Tisíce lidí se přidaly k protestu, protože byly ceny příliš vysoké.
accepts: Thousands of people joined the protest because the prices were too high

sentences.en: Education is more important now than it was fifty years ago.
sentences.cz: Vzdělání je dnes důležitější, než bylo před padesáti lety.
accepts: Education is more important now than it was fifty years ago

sentences.en: The report on the accident was two pages long.
sentences.cz: Reportáž o té nehodě byla na dvě stránky.
accepts: The report on the accident was two pages long

sentences.en: The minister gave an interview to a Czech journalist.
sentences.cz: Ministr poskytl rozhovor českému novináři.
accepts: The minister gave an interview to a Czech journalist

sentences.en: This channel shows the news every hour.
sentences.cz: Tenhle kanál dává zprávy každou hodinu.
accepts: This channel shows the news every hour

sentences.en: The press asked the same question three times.
sentences.cz: Tisk se třikrát zeptal na tu samou otázku.
accepts: The press asked the same question three times

sentences.en: The police will investigate the fire at the school.
sentences.cz: Policie bude vyšetřovat ten požár ve škole.
accepts: The police will investigate the fire at the school

sentences.en: The editor did not print the story about the hospital.
sentences.cz: Redaktor ten článek o nemocnici neotiskl.
accepts: The editor did not print the story about the hospital
The editor didn't print the story about the hospital

sentences.en: The station will broadcast the game on Sunday evening.
sentences.cz: Stanice odvysílá ten zápas v neděli večer.
accepts: The station will broadcast the game on Sunday evening

sentences.en: The coverage of the election was better on the radio.
sentences.cz: Zpravodajství o volbách bylo lepší v rádiu.
accepts: The coverage of the election was better on the radio

sentences.en: The scandal cost the minister his job.
sentences.cz: Ten skandál stál ministra místo.
accepts: The scandal cost the minister his job

sentences.en: The government wants to spend more on schools.
sentences.cz: Vláda chce dávat víc peněz do škol.
accepts: The government wants to spend more on schools

sentences.en: No politician answered the question about the new tax.
sentences.cz: Žádný politik na otázku o nové dani neodpověděl.
accepts: No politician answered the question about the new tax

sentences.en: The new law starts at the beginning of next year.
sentences.cz: Nový zákon začne platit na začátku příštího roku.
accepts: The new law starts at the beginning of next year

sentences.en: The debate on the radio lasted more than an hour.
sentences.cz: Debata v rádiu trvala víc než hodinu.
accepts: The debate on the radio lasted more than an hour

sentences.en: Her party won the election in every big city.
sentences.cz: Její strana vyhrála volby v každém velkém městě.
accepts: Her party won the election in every big city

sentences.en: The poll says half the country wants a change.
sentences.cz: Průzkum říká, že polovina země chce změnu.
accepts: The poll says half the country wants a change

sentences.en: She gave her vote to the youngest candidate.
sentences.cz: Svůj hlas dala nejmladšímu kandidátovi.
accepts: She gave her vote to the youngest candidate

sentences.en: The minister for health spoke on the news last night.
sentences.cz: Ministr zdravotnictví včera večer mluvil ve zprávách.
accepts: The minister for health spoke on the news last night

sentences.en: Workers have rights, and the union explains them.
sentences.cz: Zaměstnanci mají práva a odbory jim je vysvětlují.
accepts: Workers have rights, and the union explains them

sentences.en: The company has international offices in six countries.
sentences.cz: Ta firma má mezinárodní pobočky v šesti zemích.
accepts: The company has international offices in six countries

sentences.en: Her campaign lasted six weeks and cost a lot of money.
sentences.cz: Její kampaň trvala šest týdnů a stála spoustu peněz.
accepts: Her campaign lasted six weeks and cost a lot of money

sentences.en: The crisis started when the biggest bank closed.
sentences.cz: Krize začala, když zavřela největší banka.
accepts: The crisis started when the biggest bank closed

sentences.en: The tax on petrol went up again in January.
sentences.cz: Daň z benzinu se v lednu zase zvýšila.
accepts: The tax on petrol went up again in January

sentences.en: The health service needs more doctors and nurses.
sentences.cz: Zdravotnictví potřebuje víc lékařů a sester.
accepts: The health service needs more doctors and nurses

sentences.en: The storm was the worst disaster in the country for years.
sentences.cz: Ta bouře byla nejhorší katastrofa v zemi za mnoho let.
accepts: The storm was the worst disaster in the country for years

sentences.en: The conflict between the two families lasted for years.
sentences.cz: Konflikt mezi těmi dvěma rodinami trval roky.
accepts: The conflict between the two families lasted for years

sentences.en: There was a rise in prices after the summer.
sentences.cz: Po létě přišel růst cen.
accepts: There was a rise in prices after the summer

sentences.en: The fall in the number of students closed two schools.
sentences.cz: Pokles počtu studentů zavřel dvě školy.
accepts: The fall in the number of students closed two schools

sentences.en: The reform of the schools will take many years.
sentences.cz: Reforma školství bude trvat mnoho let.
accepts: The reform of the schools will take many years

sentences.en: The biggest issue in this election is the health service.
sentences.cz: Největší téma těchhle voleb je zdravotnictví.
accepts: The biggest issue in this election is the health service

use_hint: Rewrite the sentence. Replace the underlined words.

use_sentences.prompt: I only read the big words at the top of the page.
use_sentences.underline: big words at the top of the page
accepts: I only read the headline

use_sentences.prompt: The government will tell everyone about the new law.
use_sentences.en: The government will announce the new law.
accepts: The government will announce the new law

use_sentences.prompt: The police will find out what caused the fire.
use_sentences.en: The police will investigate the fire.
accepts: The police will investigate the fire

use_sentences.prompt: The person who decides what the paper prints said no.
use_sentences.underline: person who decides what the paper prints
accepts: The editor said no

use_sentences.prompt: People choose a new government next year.
use_sentences.en: There is an election next year.
accepts: There is an election next year

use_sentences.prompt: The paper asked a thousand people what they think.
use_sentences.underline: asked a thousand people what they think
accepts: The paper did a poll

use_sentences.prompt: The country is in very serious trouble with money.
use_sentences.en: The country is in a crisis with money.
accepts: The country is in a crisis with money

use_sentences.prompt: The storm was the worst thing that has happened here for years.
use_sentences.underline: worst thing that has happened here
use_sentences.en: The storm was the worst disaster here for years.
accepts: The storm was the worst disaster here for years

use_sentences.prompt: Prices went up after the summer.
use_sentences.en: There was a rise in prices after the summer.
accepts: There was a rise in prices after the summer

use_sentences.prompt: The government will change the schools from the beginning.
use_sentences.underline: change the schools from the beginning
use_sentences.en: The government will reform the schools.
accepts: The government will reform the schools

use_sentences.prompt: Everybody talked for weeks about what the minister did wrong.
use_sentences.en: Everybody talked for weeks about the scandal.
accepts: Everybody talked for weeks about the scandal

use_sentences.prompt: The radio reported the election better than the paper.
use_sentences.en: The radio coverage of the election was better than the paper.
accepts: The radio coverage of the election was better than the paper
